concept.title: Example: How metadata elements cascade from one map to another
concept.shortdesc: In this scenario, a metadata element that is located in a map reference cascades to the topics that are referenced in a nested map.

conbody.p:
Assume the following parent map and the referenced nested map install.ditamap: Parent map: <map> <title>Product quick start</title> <mapref href="install.ditamap"> <topicmeta> <author>Emma Author</author> </topicmeta> </mapref> <!-- ... --> </map>
install.ditamap: <map> <title>Installation</title> <topicmeta> <author>Bob Author</author> </topicmeta> <topicref href="install.dita"> <!-- ... --> </topicref> </map>

The author information specified on the map reference cascades into the referenced map. Both Emma Author and Bob Author apply to install.dita, in addition to any author metadata specified within that topic.
